summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests amivantamab given under the skin as a co-formulation with recombinant human hyaluronidase PH20, in combination with other drugs, for advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, including EGFR-mutated disease. Amivantamab is given as a subcutaneous injection, and in the first-line EGFR exon19del or L858R cohort it is given on Cycle 1 Days 1, 8, 15 and 22 and then on Days 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle, with lazertinib 240 mg by mouth once daily. The study measures anti-tumor activity and safety.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 prueba amivantamab administrado debajo de la piel como una co-formulación con la hialuronidasa humana recombinante PH20, en combinación con otros medicamentos, para el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas avanzado o metastásico, incluida la enfermedad con mutación de EGFR. Amivantamab se administra como inyección subcutánea y, en la cohorte de primera línea con mutación EGFR exón 19 o L858R, se aplica en el Ciclo 1, días 1, 8, 15 y 22, y luego en los días 1 y 15 de cada ciclo de 28 días, junto con lazertinib 240 mg por vía oral una vez al día. El estudio mide la actividad antitumoral y la seguridad.
who_for: Advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer that cannot be cured with surgery or chemoradiation.
EGFR exon 19 deletion or exon 21 L858R mutation (most cohorts).
No prior systemic therapy for advanced or metastatic lung cancer (cohorts 1, 2, 5 and 6).
Disease progressed after osimertinib or after amivantamab plus lazertinib (cohorts 3, 3b and 7); ECOG 0 or 1.
not_for: Interstitial lung disease, including drug-induced ILD or radiation pneumonitis.
History of allergy to any excipients of the study products in the enrolled cohort.
Squamous non-small cell lung cancer (cohorts 2, 3, 3b and 7).
Cohort 4 requires current amivantamab IV every 2 weeks for at least 8 weeks.
Remaining exclusion criteria not stated (record text is cut off).
